capture.boundary_recording_order: For each received text frame, record any due primary-window open/game-start boundary using the current pre-frame reconstructed state before applying that frame.
capture.late_launch_policy: FAIL_CLOSED before network capture if collector begins after earliest_primary_window_start - 120s
capture.prearm_data_role: engineering state initialization only; never counts toward M1 transition density/breadth

primary_window.rule: Primary M1 engineering transition eligibility is start-1800s <= local raw-frame receive time < start.

continuity.ws_book_snapshot_generation_rule: No generation increment while local state is valid; increment generation if a WS full-book snapshot restores an invalid or uninitialized local state.

orderbook_semantics.book_event: authoritative full aggregated book snapshot for the token within the current connection/generation
orderbook_semantics.frame_atomicity: all changes for a token in one received raw frame are applied before any post-frame state is emitted
orderbook_semantics.ingest_sequence_semantics: Reserve exactly one monotonically increasing ingest_sequence per top-level decoded websocket message immediately after frame parsing. The mutation pass and all normalized records belonging to that top-level message share that reserved sequence; changes within one price_change message are ordered by change_index. No second sequence increment occurs during normalization.
orderbook_semantics.price_change_size: absolute current aggregated size at the specified price level, not an additive delta
orderbook_semantics.raw_frame_receive_time: timestamp exactly once before JSON parsing; all normalized records from the frame inherit it
orderbook_semantics.stale_ws_guard: A state-mutating WS book/price_change/tick_size_change with venue timestamp strictly older than the token last authoritative venue timestamp is preserved raw/normalized but not applied to local state.
orderbook_semantics.venue_timestamp_ordering_role: engineering reconstruction only; never H6 causal/event clock
